sentences.en: Kozue has never given way to despair in her life.
sentences.zh: 小雪一生中从未向绝望屈服过。

sentences.en: His failure in the examination drove him to despair.
sentences.zh: 考试失败使他陷入了绝望。

sentences.en: We were happy people before you came. Your arrival brought despair.
sentences.zh: 在你出现之前我们是快乐的人。你的到来带来了绝望。

senses.zh: 绝望 - 使人绝望的人(或事物) -
